primary_meaning: Jesus Christ himself as the exclusive entrance or means of access to salvation, the sheepfold of God's people, and eternal life
primary_basis: John 10:7-9 (I am the door/gate of the sheep; if anyone enters by me he will be saved)
John 14:6 (I am the way... no one comes to the Father except through me)
Matthew 7:13-14 (enter by the narrow gate that leads to life)

alternatives.meaning: An open opportunity for gospel ministry, mission, or service
Christ standing at the door of the human heart or church, seeking entrance and fellowship
Access to heaven, God's presence, or the heavenly throne room
The gates/powers of Hades or death that cannot prevail against the church
Protection, security, or the boundary of the city/people of God

notes: Across historic and modern Christian teaching the Johannine 'I am the door/gate' saying is the most consistently cited and dominant symbolic identification; other uses (opportunity, heavenly access, heart's door, protective boundary) are frequent but secondary and context-specific rather than rival primaries.
